$comment: The security audit agent's settings, passed to claude-code-action via the settings input. Registers the read-confinement hook (see read-confinement.settings.json) and the write-confinement hook, which judges Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit on the resolved path, so a symlink in a pull request's tree cannot carry the report write out of the workspace, into .git, or onto Claude Code's project settings. The workflow stages the scripts and this file to $RUNNER_TEMP/read-confinement/ before the agent starts, outside the workspace, and runs the staged copies. Each command ends in `|| exit 2`: a hook that crashes is a non-blocking error in Claude Code, so any failure to decide must block the call instead. See .github/agent-runtime/confine-writes-to-worktree.mjs.
